title.zh: DeepSeek完成约1000亿元人民币第二轮融资，腾讯与宁德时代领投
title.en: DeepSeek closes second RMB100B funding round led by Tencent and CATL

current_state.zh: DeepSeek 已完成第二轮约1055亿元人民币（约158亿美元）融资，腾讯和宁德时代仍为主要投资方，国有投资者约占本轮27%，融资资金部分用于应对芯片采购成本上升和建立资金储备。
current_state.en: DeepSeek has completed a second funding round of about RMB105.5B (~$15.8B), with Tencent and CATL remaining major investors, state-owned investors contributing about 27% of the round, and proceeds partly aimed at rising chip procurement costs and building a financial buffer.

updates.title_zh: DeepSeek或将完成约120亿美元融资，腾讯和宁德时代或参投
updates.title_en: DeepSeek或将完成约120亿美元融资，腾讯和宁德时代或参投
updates.what_changed_zh: 据报道，DeepSeek 正在完成一轮至少 800 亿元人民币（约合 120 亿美元）的融资，远高于其此前 500 亿元的目标，腾讯和宁德时代承诺认购其中很大一部分，此前其最新模型发布后需求和投资者兴趣激增。
updates.what_changed_en: DeepSeek is reportedly closing a funding round of at least ¥80B (~$12B), well above its earlier ¥50B target, with Tencent and CATL committing significant portions as demand and investor interest surge following its latest model release.
updates.current_state_zh: 据报道，DeepSeek 正在完成一轮至少 800 亿元人民币（约合 120 亿美元）的融资，远高于其此前 500 亿元的目标，腾讯和宁德时代承诺认购其中很大一部分，此前其最新模型发布后需求和投资者兴趣激增。

updates.what_changed_zh: 融资规模从此前报道的至少800亿元人民币进一步提高至约1000亿元人民币，投前估值仍约5000亿元人民币，新进产业投资方包括石溪资本、中芯聚源、CPE源峰、君联资本、吉利等。
updates.what_changed_en: The funding size increased from the previously reported at least ¥80B to roughly ¥100B, with the pre-money valuation unchanged at about ¥500B and new industrial investors including Shixi Capital, SMIC Capital, CPE, Legend Capital, and Geely.
updates.current_state_zh: DeepSeek 据报即将完成第二轮融资，规模约1000亿元人民币，投前估值约5000亿元人民币，新老股东拟投资金额约各占一半，新进投资方以产业投资方为主。
updates.current_state_en: DeepSeek is reportedly set to close its second funding round at roughly ¥100B, with a pre-money valuation of about ¥500B; new and existing shareholders are expected to split the round roughly evenly, with new industrial investors taking part.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: DeepSeek is set to close its second funding round at roughly 100 billion yuan — double the previously planned 50 billion yuan — at an unchanged pre-money valuation of about 500 billion yuan, with new industrial investors including Shixi Capital, SMIC Capital, CPE, Legend Capital and Geely taking about half of the round.
updates.detailed_summary_en: DeepSeek is set to close its second funding round at roughly 100 billion yuan — double the previously planned 50 billion yuan — at an unchanged pre-money valuation of about 500 billion yuan, with new industrial investors including Shixi Capital, SMIC Capital, CPE, Legend Capital and Geely taking about half of the round.

updates.title_zh: 彭博：DeepSeek完成第二轮1000亿元融资，腾讯、宁德时代出资最多
updates.title_en: 彭博：DeepSeek完成第二轮1000亿元融资，腾讯、宁德时代出资最多
updates.what_changed_zh: DeepSeek 完成第二轮 1000 亿元人民币融资，由腾讯和宁德时代领投，投前估值维持约 5000 亿元人民币不变，两轮融资总额约 1500 亿元人民币，同时准备最早于 2026 年底提交科创板 IPO 申请。
updates.what_changed_en: DeepSeek closed a second 100B RMB funding round led by Tencent and CATL at an unchanged ~500B RMB pre-money valuation, bringing two-round total to ~150B RMB, while preparing a STAR Market IPO filing as early as end-2026.

updates.current_state_en: DeepSeek closed a second 100B RMB funding round led by Tencent and CATL at an unchanged ~500B RMB pre-money valuation, bringing two-round total to ~150B RMB, while preparing a STAR Market IPO filing as early as end-2026.

updates.detailed_summary_en: DeepSeek closed a second 100B RMB funding round led by Tencent and CATL at an unchanged ~500B RMB pre-money valuation, bringing two-round total to ~150B RMB, while preparing a STAR Market IPO filing as early as end-2026.
updates.background_zh: 美国国土安全部以国家安全风险为由，下令从联邦系统中移除并排除 DeepSeek 产品；该指令还禁止采购这家中国公司的产品，并涵盖基于其 AI 模型构建的第三方服务。《纽约时报》报道称，中国已批评美国在政府系统中禁用 DeepSeek，并指出国土安全部并非首个限制该公司工具的联邦或州级机构。DeepSeek 研发并开源前沿大语言模型，包括 DeepSeek-V4 和 DeepSeek-R1，并提供聊天与 API 服务。
updates.background_en: The Homeland Security Department ordered the removal and exclusion of DeepSeek products from federal systems, citing national-security risks, and the directive also barred purchases of the Chinese firm's products and covered third-party services built on its AI models. The New York Times reported that China criticized the U.S. ban on DeepSeek in government systems, and noted DHS is not the first federal or state agency to restrict the company's tools. DeepSeek develops and open-sources frontier large language models, including DeepSeek-V4 and DeepSeek-R1, and offers chat and API access.
updates.market_impact_zh: DeepSeek 是一家私营 AI 开发商，没有代币敞口，因此传导路径主要来自市场情绪与资本流向，而非直接资产持仓：如此规模的融资报道会强化“中国 AI 资本形成在美国限制下仍在延续”的叙事，这一因素可能影响市场对中国相关 AI 股票以及受算力与出口管制影响板块的情绪。
updates.market_impact_en: DeepSeek is a private AI developer with no token exposure, so any transmission runs through sentiment and capital flows rather than direct asset holdings: a raise of this reported size would reinforce the narrative of continued Chinese AI capital formation despite U.S. restrictions, a factor that can colour sentiment toward China-linked AI equities and to compute and export-control-sensitive segments.
